case-studies.title: Ludhiana Logistics Park LLP
case-studies.buildUpArea: 0.53 Million Sqft (Including Mezzanine and Ancillary Buildings)
case-studies.introduction: Ludhiana Logistics Park LLP undertook the development of a warehouse facility in Doraha, Ludhiana, Punjab. The project involved the construction of a state-of-the-art logistics park to accommodate two major tenants, Flipkart and Ecom Express.
case-studies.overview: The project site spanned 22.73 acres and was completed in two phases. The logistics park encompassed a plinth area of 0.48 million square feet and a built-up area of 0.53 million square feet.
engagement: PISL was involved as the design, project management, and construction partner
Provided comprehensive support to the developer and investors
Managed local nearby landowners during boundary wall construction
Coordinated with both tenants for smooth construction
challenges: COVID-19 Impact: Restrictions and lockdown during second wave
Natural Calamity: Windstorm and heavy rain damaged PEB structure
Design Changes: Multiple changes to optimize project costs
achievements: Phase 1 completed within 6 months
Phase 2 completed within 7 months
Completed within committed deadlines
State-of-the-art facility for Flipkart and Ecom Express
case-studies.conclusion: The Ludhiana Logistics Park LLP project demonstrated successful collaboration despite COVID-19, natural calamity, and design changes. The facility now serves as a crucial logistics hub.

case-studies.title: Bluestar Realtors Ltd
case-studies.introduction: Bluestar Realtors Ltd undertook the development of a state-of-the-art warehouse facility in Palwal, Haryana. The project was executed for Adani Group under a comprehensive Design & Build contract, showcasing PISL's expertise in delivering turnkey industrial infrastructure solutions.
case-studies.overview: The project encompassed 4.8 Lakh Sq. Ft of built-up area, completed between 2022-2024. PISL served as the Design & Build partner, managing the entire project lifecycle from conception to handover with precision engineering and quality execution.
engagement: Complete project management from concept to commissioning
Structural design and PEB engineering coordination
challenges: Tight project timeline of 24 months for complete delivery
Coordination with multiple stakeholders including Adani Group representatives
Managing construction during extreme weather conditions in Haryana
Supply chain optimization for PEB and structural materials
Integration of specialized MEP requirements for warehouse operations
achievements: Successfully delivered 4.8 Lakh Sq. Ft facility within committed timeline
Zero safety incidents throughout the project duration
Achieved cost optimization through value engineering
Completed all quality milestones as per Adani Group standards
Seamless handover with complete documentation and compliance certificates
Established long-term relationship with Bluestar Realtors for future projects
case-studies.conclusion: The Bluestar Realtors project in Palwal stands as a testament to PISL's capability in executing large-scale Design & Build contracts for Grade-A clients like Adani Group. The successful delivery reinforced PISL's reputation as a trusted industrial infrastructure partner.

about-page.overviewText:
We at PISL are recognised as India's leading construction company, providing services to well-reputed clientele in various sectors.

PISL is the product of passion, hard work, and integrity. To us, excellence is a habit, and we always strive to do our best. We are an organisation with a strong ethical compass and a spectacular track record of excellence in the industry. Over the past 17+ years, our proven expertise has led us to build multiple projects covering millions of square meters in the construction industry.

We are present across various sectors like copper smelting, food processing, radial wires, automobile, heavy engineering, MSME, chemical, and other sectors.

With a strong background in engineering and construction, we know how to make ideas and plans become real things. We are in the relentless pursuit of value creation, skill-building, and strengthening the infrastructural fabric of the nation with our passion and commitment.

rules.descEn: Always protect yourself against fall while ascending, descending or working at height (1.8 meters).
rules.descHi: ऊंचाई (1.8 मीटर) पर चढ़ते, उतरते या काम करते समय हमेशा अपने आप को गिरने से बचाएं।

rules.descEn: Always perform a HSE Tool Box Talk. Work with a valid work permit when required.
rules.descHi: काम शुरू करने से पहले हमेशा टूल बॉक्स टॉक करें। हमेशा वैध वर्क परमिट के साथ काम करें।

rules.descEn: All Incidents must be recorded, reported, investigated and recommendations acted upon in a time bound manner.
rules.descHi: सभी घटनाओं को दर्ज किया जाना चाहिए, रिपोर्ट किया जाना चाहिए और जांच की जानी चाहिए।

rules.descEn: Never enter into an excavation unless safe access/egress, adequate barricades are provided and soil is sufficiently supported/sloped.
rules.descHi: खुदाई में कभी भी प्रवेश न करें जब तक कि सुरक्षित रास्ता, पर्याप्त बैरिकेड न दिए गए हों और मिट्टी को सहारा न दिया गया हो।

rules.descEn: Always obtain authorisation before entering a confined space.
rules.descHi: कन्फाइंड स्पेस में प्रवेश करने से पहले हमेशा अनुमति लें।

rules.descEn: Never remove or bypass safety barricades and warning signages. Do not enter in unauthorized areas.
rules.descHi: सुरक्षा बैरिकेड्स और चेतावनी संकेतों को कभी न हटाएं। अनधिकृत क्षेत्रों में प्रवेश न करें।

rules.descEn: Always assure your competency and fitness for your job. Do not enter the premises under the influence of drugs or alcohol.
rules.descHi: हमेशा सुनिश्चित करें कि आप अपने काम के लिए फिट हैं। शराब या ड्रग्स के प्रभाव में कार्यस्थल पर प्रवेश न करें।

rules.descEn: Always keep yourself and others out of the line of fire. (E.g. moving vehicles, suspended loads, tensioned lines)
rules.descHi: हमेशा अपने आप को और दूसरों को खतरे की रेखा से बाहर रखें। (जैसे- चलती गाड़ियां, लटका हुआ भार)

rules.descEn: Do not use defective lifting tools and tackles. Never stand or walk under suspended loads.
rules.descHi: खराब लिफ्टिंग उपकरणों का उपयोग न करें। लटके हुए भार के नीचे कभी खड़े न हों या चलें।

rules.descEn: Always comply with traffic rules, specified speed limit and do not use mobile phones while driving.
rules.descHi: हमेशा यातायात नियमों और गति सीमा का पालन करें। ड्राइविंग करते समय मोबाइल फोन का उपयोग न करें।

rules.descEn: Always verify energy isolation & zero energy state before working on energized equipment/network.
rules.descHi: मशीन पर काम करने से पहले हमेशा ऊर्जा के अलगाव और शून्य ऊर्जा की स्थिति को सुनिश्चित करें।

rules.descEn: Ensure to keep area free from flammable materials and maintain proper firefighting equipment prior to start hot work.
rules.descHi: हॉट वर्क शुरू करने से पहले ज्वलनशील पदार्थों को हटाएं और आग बुझाने के उचित उपकरण रखें।

grids.title: Construction (Considerations)
grids.description: When undertaking warehouse construction, numerous warehouse design and construction intricacies must be taken into account to achieve a successful development. Working with an experienced contractor who is actively involved in the design and early stages of a project ensures optimal results.

items.title: 1. Floor Systems
items.description: Choosing the right warehouse floor system necessitates an understanding of concrete kinds, site dynamics, and how a space will be used. Concrete floors can be reinforced or unreinforced, freezer/cooler compatible, shrinkage compensating, and tailored to the user's floor loads and equipment route requirements.

items.title: 2. Exterior Wall Types
items.description: Selecting warehouse exterior walls considers factors like size and schedule. Large facilities often opt for on-site poured concrete panels, which are cost-effective and have versatile finishes. Precast panels, produced offsite, suit tight schedules and are ideal for installation before the floor slab.

items.title: 3. Building Structure
items.description: In planning a warehouse, factors like roof loads, wall cladding, and storage heights must be factored in. Engineered steel joists, rafters, and columns can span considerable distances and support substantial roof loads. For tall storage needs, rack-supported structures optimise space.

items.title: 4. Bay Sizing
items.description: Bay sizing and rack design are critical elements in the warehouse building. The width and clear height of the structure are used to determine forklift travel pathways, aisle widths and racking layouts. A skilled warehouse contractor is critical to guaranteeing successful construction.

items.title: 5. Building Systems
items.description: Decisions on dock types, sizes, and specifications have significance throughout the design phase. The functional requirements dictate whether mechanical or hydraulic docks are used. Electrical service, HVAC, fire protection, and lighting are all factors to consider with strict adherence to code standards.

items.title: 6. Site Design & Selection
items.description: Guidelines dictate parking ratios, dock size, and office space distribution. PISL's expertise guarantees efficient and functional space utilisation. Our site feasibility services empower clients to make informed decisions by providing cost information and aiding in schedule considerations before construction.
